steel.description: Set the frame plumb, level & square.
requirements: Set the frame plumb, level & square; complete frame installation.

steel.description: Verify frame opening number matches location number.
requirements: Locate the frame at the door opening location. Verify that the frame opening number matches the actual opening location number.
Compare the handing and size of the frame to the drawing.
Verify that the proper hardware reinforcements are installed on the frame.
Verify the hinge size, strike type and closer mounting.

steel.description: Anchor usage requirement based on wall components.
requirements: A standard 5-3/4" steel stud anchor will be used when your wall system consists of a 3-5/8" steel stud using 5/8" drywall on each side.

steel.description: Adjust frames to match floor finish thickness.
requirements: Adjust the frames to match the floor finish thickness.
Most frames are provided with adjustable base anchors that allow you to adapt for floor surfaces up to 1-3/8”.
The most important tab connection is at the rabbeted part of the frame.
Those tabs should be bent in an outward position.
Install base anchors to the frame using the screws provided.
The temporary shipping bar must be properly removed by grinding it off.
Do not bend or twist it off.

steel.description: Restriction on use of temporary shipping bar.
requirements: This temporary bar should not to be used as a spreader bar to set the frame.

steel.description: Stud placement prior to frame installation.
requirements: The steel studs should be in place, leaving out the studs around the rough opening.
Place the properly sized spreader between the hinge and strike jambs at the floor.
Check the spreader to ensure that it has been cut squarely and accurately.
Anchor the base anchors to the floor on each jamb using a concrete screw or drive pin anchor.
Install a minimum of six anchors.
Place three on the hinge jamb and three on the strike jamb.
An anchor must be above each hinge and directly across at the same height on the strike jamb.
Place another mid-frame spreader in between the hinge and strike jambs to keep the frame straight and aligned.
Check the head of the frame for level accuracy.
If necessary, adjust the base anchors to achieve a level head and proper floor clearance.
Move the studding in place and begin screwing the studs to the track at the bottom.
Install screws on each side of the stud.
Once the base of the stud is anchored, proceed with securing the studs against each jamb to the top steel stud plate.
Install screws on both sides of the stud.
Install the header above the frame.
The studs should be perpendicular to the steel stud track.
The dimension between the jambs should be the same at the top and bottom of the frame.
Check the frame again for plumb, level and square accuracy.
Secure the top steel stud anchor on the strike jamb with screws.
Check the hinge and strike jambs for plumb accuracy in all directions.
Position the top of the hinge jamb to the stud so that it will accept the proper thickness drywall on each side.
Bend the anchor ear around the stud to hold the anchor in place.
Attach the anchor to the stud with the screws provided.
Screw the remainder of the frame anchors into the studs after verifying the dimension and trueness of the frame.
Secure each anchor with a minimum of two screws.
After the frame is secured to the studs and tightly anchored, check it again for trueness and accuracy in all directions.

steel.description: Position hinge jamb relative to drywall thickness.
requirements: Position the top of the hinge jamb to the stud so that it will accept the proper thickness drywall on each side.
Bend the anchor ear around the stud to hold the anchor in place.
Attach the anchor to the stud with the screws provided.
Check the frame for plumb.
Verify the dimension and trueness of the frame, then screw the remainder of the frame anchors into the studs.
Secure each anchor with a minimum of two screws.
When using wood stud anchors, bend the ears tightly against the stud.
After the frame is secured to the studs and tightly anchored, check it again for trueness and accuracy in all directions.

steel.description: Final frame securing after drywall placement.
requirements: Once the drywall is in place, re-plumb the frame and then anchor off the drywall.

drywall.description: Frame positioning relative to drywall thickness.
requirements: Make sure that the frame is positioned to allow for the thickness of the drywall.
The drywall installer should check that the frame is plumb, level and square before hanging the drywall.
The installer should avoid excessive shoving of the drywall into the hinge, strike or head jambs because this may throw the frame out of alignment.
During the drywall installation, chamfer back the edge of the drywall so that it will slip over studding screw heads that may be present around the frame.
As you install the drywall, gently work it in and around the frame, trying to avoid knocking the frame out of alignment.

drywall.description: Re-plumbing and anchoring after drywall is in place.
requirements: Once the drywall is in place, re-plumb the frame and then anchor off the drywall.

drywall.description: Pre-hanging frame check and installation technique.
requirements: Check that the frame is plumb, level and square before hanging the drywall.
Avoid excessive shoving of the drywall into the hinge, strike or head jambs because this may throw the frame out of alignment.
Chamfer back the edge of the drywall so that it will slip over studding screw heads that may be present around the frame.
Gently work the drywall in and around the frame, trying to avoid knocking the frame out of alignment.

drywall.description: Final trueness check before securing drywall.
requirements: Check the frame again for trueness before screwing the drywall off to the perimeter studs around the frame.
If your installation requires electrical components, install conduits or flex cable for low voltage wiring now.

electrician.description: Verify electrical wiring needs during Step 3.
requirements: If the opening requires it, verify electrical wiring needs.

electrician.description: Verify wiring needs based on opening requirements.
requirements: If the opening requires it, verify electrical wiring needs.

carpenter.description: Bending ears on wood stud anchors.
requirements: When using wood stud anchors, bend the ears tightly against the stud.

tiler.description: Maximum thickness note for certain tile finishes.
requirements: Some wood and tile finishes, such as quarry, are up to 3/4" thick.
Select the right materials and tools for this project.
Test the door to ensure that it is functioning properly.
Check the hardware schedule.
Contract your distributor if information does not match.

unspecified.description: Verification of floor specifications if frame is set early.
requirements: If you are installing the door frame before the floor is installed, it is critical to know the specifications of the floor that will be laid.
We recommend that you contact your job supervisor in advance to verify the floor anchor requirements of the finish flooring.
For additional guidance on anchor placement, consult the industry standards published by SDI.

unspecified.description: Requirement for spreaders during drywall hanging.
requirements: Spreaders should be left in place during hanging of drywall to help prevent the frame from being knocked out of plumb.
